title: Accessibility Agents findings
description: What every scanning skill returns. Routers merge these; scripts render reports, CSV, VPAT and statements from them. One shape, so nothing downstream has to parse prose.

skill.description: Name of the skill that produced this payload, matching its directory.

scope.description: Files, URLs or components examined. Empty means nothing was in scope.

rule.description: Stable rule identifier, for example ARIA-002 or PDFUA.7.1.

wcag.description: WCAG 2.2 success criterion number and level, for example '1.3.1 A'. Use 'n/a' for findings outside WCAG.

confidence.description: How sure the skill is without runtime verification. Omit when high.

location.description: file.ext:line, a CSS selector, a slide or page number, or a URL. Must point somewhere a person can open.

fix.description: What to change, concretely enough to act on without re-reading the file.

evidence.description: The offending markup, value or measurement. Keep it short.

component.description: Component or template this belongs to, when the same defect repeats across pages.

passed.description: Checks run that found nothing. Reports need these to distinguish 'clean' from 'not checked'.

notes.description: Anything a person must decide, and anything the skill could not check. Not findings.
